topics.label: Introduction to the Lecture on Complement
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic provides the opening welcome and framing for the lecture.

topics.label: Foundational Principles and Architecture of Complement
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics establish the general framework, nomenclature rules, and central role of C3 in the complement system.

topics.label: Pathways of Complement Activation
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain the three upstream pathways that recognize pathogens and trigger complement activation.

topics.label: Effector Functions of Complement
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics detail the three primary mechanisms by which activated complement destroys pathogens and mediates inflammation.

topics.label: Host Regulation of Complement
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic explains how host regulatory factors prevent complement from attacking and destroying self cells.

topics.label: Clinical Complement Deficiencies
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic examines how defects in specific complement components lead to distinct clinical pathologies.

topics.label: Pathogen Evasion Mechanisms
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic illustrates how pathogens circumvent complement-mediated destruction and how these evasion factors are utilized in biotechnology.

topics.label: Conclusion and Upcoming Topics
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic delivers the closing remarks and previews the next lecture.
